name: smith front squat
description: A front squat with the bar guided by the smith machine. It trains the quads with an upright torso.
instructions: Set the bar at shoulder height and rest it on the front of your shoulders with elbows up.
Unrack it and step your feet slightly forward.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbows high and your chest up.
Press through your heels to stand and rerack when done.
